title: Post-OCR Correction of Mixed-Script Uzbek Text: Byte-Level ByT5 with an Empirical Homoglyph Noise Matrix
abstract: arXiv:2611.13609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In Uzbek official and technical documents, a large share of OCR errors is caused not by poor image quality but by characters that are visually identical across the two alphabets in use. Because the script transition is still under way, Cyrillic and Latin appear on the same page and often within a single sentence, and in our measurements the density of homoglyph errors on such pages is close to five times higher than in single-script text. We study this problem in a setting where the corpus of engineering-geological and ICT infrastructure reports may not leave the organisation, so every stage was executed on local hardware. The proposed system combines a byte-level ByT5 model with a noise generator whose sampling weights are estimated from 359 manually classified error events, together with a Levenshtein-bounded conservative decoding rule. translated_title: 乌兹别克语混合文字文本的OCR后纠错：基于经验同形字符噪声矩阵的字节级ByT5模型
translated_abstract: 在乌兹别克斯坦的官方和技术文档中，很大一部分OCR错误并非由图像质量差造成，而是由当前并用的两种字母表中视觉上完全相同的字符所引起。由于文字转型仍在进行中，西里尔字母与拉丁字母会出现在同一页面上，甚至经常出现在同一句话中；据我们的测量，此类页面上同形字符错误的密度约为单一文字文本的近五倍。我们在一个特殊受限的场景下研究该问题：工程地质与ICT基础设施报告语料库不得离开本机构，因此所有阶段均在本地硬件上执行。所提出的系统将字节级ByT5模型与一个噪声生成器相结合，该生成器的采样权重由359个人工分类的错误事件估计得出，并辅以受莱文斯坦距离约束的保守解码规则。在包含5,204个行对的黄金测试集上，该系统将字符错误率从0.0578降低至0.0369，并恢复了……
tldr: 针对乌兹别克语中西里尔与拉丁字母混排导致的同形字符OCR错误，提出可在本地硬件上运行的字节级ByT5纠错系统，结合由人工标注错误事件估计的噪声矩阵与保守解码规则，将字符错误率从0.0578降至0.0369。
en_tdlr: A locally deployable byte-level ByT5 system, combined with an empirically estimated homoglyph noise matrix and Levenshtein-bounded conservative decoding, corrects mixed-script Uzbek OCR errors and reduces the character error rate from 0.0578 to 0.0369.
